dress_and_conduct: Cover thighs to the knee in town or a village; beachwear is fine at hotels and resorts.
Ask permission before photographing people and places; kastoms vary between provinces.
sacred_or_restricted_places: Before going ashore, try to get permission from the relevant chief first.
culture-and-protocol.cultural_authority: Local chiefs; the province (yachts must notify each province they wish to visit).
culture-and-protocol.note: National guidance from Tourism Solomons applied to this province; no province-specific page found.
